final: WITH g AS (SELECT zoneref AS z, SUM(articount) AS s FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY zoneref), t AS (SELECT SUM(s) AS tot FROM g), f AS (SELECT g.z, g.s, g.s*1.0/t.tot AS frac FROM g JOIN t ON t.tot IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(frac) AS av FROM f) SELECT f.z, f.s, f.frac, f.frac - a.av AS diff FROM f JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
